notes: Null means unknown; it is not a clean or passing result. The classifier does not fit data or verify these human-supplied assessments.

denominator_definitions.disease_donors: Unique donor backgrounds contributing disease models, including an independently engineered donor background. This is not automatically the number of affected patients.
denominator_definitions.independent_disease_backgrounds: Distinct donor/genetic backgrounds, not clones or different engineered genotypes from the same donor.
denominator_definitions.reference_donors: Reference backgrounds may overlap source donors used for engineered disease models; do not sum categories into a unique-donor count.
